title: TimeNet Dataset Card
description: Human-authored metadata for a TimeNet dataset: the card YAML that sits beside a connector and is the single source for the dataset's descriptive identity.

yaml_schema_version.description: The card's own field-schema version. Only 1 exists today.

value_encoding.description: Values-column encoding for this dataset. 'auto' (or omit the field) lets the writer measure the data and pick per modality; 'dictionary', 'byte_stream_split', or 'plain' forces one instead. Force one only when a measurement shows the selection is wrong for this source.

datasetId.description: HuggingFace-style org/name: exactly one slash, and no segment may start with '.'.

license.description: SPDX-style license identifier. Kept in sync with timenet.types.License by a drift test.

domain.description: Kept in sync with timenet.types.Domain by a drift test.

valueEncoding.description: Parquet encoding of the shard values column. Kept in sync with timenet.writer.value_encoding.ValueEncoding by a drift test.
